item_name: Rothco G.I. All Purpose Face Paint Compact
item_short_desc: Rothco’s G.I. All Purpose Face Paint Compact features four colors that are ideal for soldiers, tactical professionals, MilSim players, hunters, and more.
description: Rothco’s G.I. All Purpose Face Paint Compact features four colors that are ideal for soldiers, tactical professionals, MilSim players, hunters, and more. The military face paint compact includes four colors: light green, loam, white, and sand. The tactical face paint compact measures 3 inches x 2 ¼ inches x ¾ inches, easily fitting in your pocket. The face paint compact contains lanolin oil and mineral oil, no nut oils are used.
